predicted_effects: At most 70 anonymous HTTPS GETs to huggingface.co /api metadata endpoints for 34 named public resources: one current-info read each, plus one pinned-revision read only where the head differs from the pin.
Local evidence writes limited to one record directory in the KINGDOM-OS PR worktree and session scratch; raw response bodies deleted before return.
No content download, gate acceptance, Space invocation, provider call, Hub write, commit or publication; GBP 0 and 0 remote GPU seconds.
observed_effects: 35 anonymous HTTPS GETs to huggingface.co /api metadata endpoints, started between 2026-10-27T18:13:19.939Z and 2026-10-27T18:14:03.448Z: 34 current-info reads and 1 pinned-revision read. All returned HTTP/2 200 application/json, with no redirect, no Set-Cookie and no retry, and no stop condition was triggered.

Received 86820 bytes (35017 header + 51803 body). Requests carried only the resource ID, one pinned revision, expand field names and the User-Agent 'Mozilla/5.0'. No token, Authorization header, cookie, netrc or curl config file was used.

Local reads: the KINGDOM-OS suite extract at b719f254 (skill, references, receipt schema, NEN.md); AgentTool Git objects at 8947c8fd, plus one blob-identity check at 3841a5fc; and the hf-kingdom-lab committed tree d8e48068 via git grep, plus its LICENSE file. The lab CLI, DataNode and data root were not opened, and no working tree was modified.

Local execution: python3 -I helper scripts and curl from session scratch; './kingdom nen list --json', 'validate', 'receipt-template' and 'verify-receipt' from the suite root, which NEN.md documents as network-free and write-free.

Local writes: this record directory (charter.yaml, evidence/requests.jsonl, evidence/observations.json and this receipt; RETURN-NOTE.md is written after this receipt) and session scratch. The 35 raw bodies, 35 header files and 35 derived-field files were deleted at 2026-10-27T18:16:42Z, after their digests and fields were recorded.
Not used: private reads, file or content downloads, gate acceptance, *.hf.space requests, provider or model calls, Jobs, Hub writes, the hf CLI or huggingface_hub, commits, pushes or publication.
The charter was preceded by untimed preparatory local reads of the suite documents, the atlas rows and the lab tree. They are included in the local reads above.

costs.compute: One laptop running curl, python3 and bun for seconds. CPU time and memory were not measured. Summed curl transfer time was 18873 ms.
costs.money: GBP 0 observed: anonymous public endpoints only, with no paid service or provider. The cost of the operator's own connectivity was not measured.
costs.privacy: Hugging Face and network intermediaries saw the 34 resource IDs, one pinned revision, request timing, a generic User-Agent and the device's public network address. No account identity, token, email, local path or private content left the device. The committed record omits local device paths.
costs.coordination: Ran as one track of a multi-track workflow on the owner's decision. Wrote only this record directory in an uncommitted PR worktree and contacted no participant. A later stage owns the documentation changes and the commit.

uncertainty: Hub metadata, cards and license fields are publisher or provider assertions. They are not legal clearance, provenance proof or safety verdicts.
That a head equals its pin rests on the API's sha field. No file tree, file bytes or per-file README digest from the atlas was re-checked, because file downloads were outside the charter.
That the atlas treasure index is byte-identical to the Hub dataset at 4ea10623… rests on a same-day audit, not on this expedition.
For hf-boundaries rows, the 07-31 'public' baseline comes from the table heading, not from a per-row gating observation. Four rows recorded no license, so their current assertions have no baseline.
Gating was not requested for the one Space. Its visibility was read from the private and disabled fields only.
Repository settings (gating, visibility, disabled) can change without a commit. This is a single snapshot taken 2026-10-27 between 18:13 and 18:14Z.
Egress bytes are estimated from uncompressed HTTP/1.1-equivalent request text. curl reported 0 for size_request over HTTP/2, so no observed value exists. TLS, TCP and DNS overhead are not counted.

The verifier checks the bound manifest and bundle digests against the local suite; it does not run Git to prove the declared revision. Instead, the suite extract's revision marker was read and the suite's relevant paths were compared with a b719f254 checkout.

The training-atlas route pins AgentTool 3841a5fc (2026-07-31). This expedition read origin/main 8947c8fd, explicitly reviewed for this run, and confirmed that the treasure-index blob is identical at both.
